'''''Juglans nigra''''' (em [[língua portuguesa|português]]: '''nogueira-preta''' ou '''nogueira-negra''') é uma espécie de [[árvore]] do gênero [[Juglans]] existente nos [[Estados Unidos]].<ref>http://www.fs.fed.us/database/feis/plants/tree/jugmic/all.html</ref><ref>{{Citar web |url=http://basketmakers.org/topics/tutorials/walnutdye.htm# |titulo=Black Walnut Basket Dye |acessodata=7 de abril de 2012 |arquivourl=https://web.archive.org/web/20081010184908/http://basketmakers.org/topics/tutorials/walnutdye.htm# |arquivodata=10 de outubro de 2008 |urlmorta=yes }}</ref><ref>[http://www.pburch.net/dyeing/dyelog/B1063361308/C1605100905/E20061005114406/ Fixing natural dyes from walnuts, goldenrod, sassafras and poke weed in cotton]</ref><ref>[http://www.bayrose.org/Poppy_Run/dyeing2_web.pdf Dyeing with Tannic Acid and Iron: Walnut Husks (2005)]</ref><ref>{{Citar web |url=http://www.nichetimbers.co.uk/hardwood/north-american-hardwood/black-walnut/# |titulo=Niche Timbers Black Walnut |acessodata=7 de abril de 2012 |arquivourl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080811233253/http://www.nichetimbers.co.uk/hardwood/north-american-hardwood/black-walnut/# |arquivodata=11 de agosto de 2008 |urlmorta=yes }}</ref><ref>[http://www.omafra.gov.on.ca/english/crops/hort/news/hortmatt/2004/28hrt04a8.htm Walnut Husk Maggot] {{Wayback|url=http://www.omafra.gov.on.ca/english/crops/hort/news/hortmatt/2004/28hrt04a8.htm# |date=20081011111952 }}. Ontario Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.</ref><ref>[http://www.ipm.ucdavis.edu/PMG/PESTNOTES/pn7430.html Walnut Husk Fly.]</ref>
